title: EvidenceRecord
description: Proof that a gate ran and what it concluded. `trust` says what the record is WORTH; it is not the same as who it names. NOTE: an earlier version of this line claimed the field names echoed the OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions so tracing would be a mapping. No field here is gen_ai.*, nobody had worked out the mapping, and scripts/emit-evidence.sh already carries the correction. A claim about future work is still a claim.

producerActorId.description: Who produced the WORK. Compared against actorAction.actorId to enforce independence.

trust.description: See shared-definitions#/definitions/evidenceTrust. A gate run by scripts/emit-evidence.sh is deterministic_runner only when a runner produced it in CI; everything else it can emit is self_reported.
